title: progress-ledger/entries/<id>.yaml
description: Phase 23: a reviewed before/after record for one Phase B round - the SupportingDataModel/DataModel split (Phase 22), or later a clinical-logic repair round. Immutable once created, like reference-sets/<id>.yaml - a round that needs correcting gets a new entry, not an edit to an old one. This is not a substitute for a unit's own status.yaml notes, a finding, or a docs/NN-*.md narrative (details_doc points at that) - it exists only to hold the small set of numbers a dashboard needs to render a timeline, so those don't have to be re-parsed out of prose.

phase.description: The reference-module plan phase this round belongs to, e.g. 22.

summary.description: 2-3 reviewer-facing sentences: what changed and why the before/after comparison shows it's safe (or, for a round that isn't, what regressed and what's being done about it).

details_doc.description: Repo-relative path to the full prose record this entry summarizes, e.g. docs/29-phase-22-before-after.md. Null only for a round with no separate narrative doc.

finding_ids.description: SPEC-<version>-NNNN findings this round resolved or is otherwise related to, if any.

status.description: pending_review: recorded but the project owner hasn't signed off yet. reviewed: the project owner has reviewed this entry's before/after and summary.

commit.description: Short git commit hash this snapshot was measured at.

fits_runtime_seconds.description: Full FitsFixtureTest run.json elapsed time, null if not measured for this round.
